d: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s concerns over missing Hindu voters in the electoral rolls have raised questions about the BJP’s own defence of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. With claims of 1.27 crore missing Hindu voters and a rise in the Muslim voter count, why has Yogi’s statement created unease within the BJP? Neeta Sharma explains the political implications ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
